name: Tianshan Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianshan Material Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of cement, clinker, ready-mixed concrete, and aggregates in China and internationally. It offers ordinary cement, including silicate cement and common silicate cement; and special cements, such as sulfoaluminate cement, oil well cement, hydraulic cement, high-temperature heavy oil cement, sulfate-resistant silicate cement, ultrafine silicate cement, road silicate cement, silicate cement for nuclear power engineering, marine cement, fast-setting and fast-hardening sulfoaluminate cement, and medium-heat and low-heat silicate cement.
